sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: RTA Cabinets Canada, based in London, Ontario, respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This policy explains what information we collect through rtacabinetscanada.ca, how we use it, who we share it with, and the choices and rights you have regarding your information. By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body:
We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
- Contact and project details submitted through our quote request forms, such as your name, email, phone number, delivery address, and the cabinets or design you are asking about
- Kitchen designs and cabinet lists you build in our free 3D Kitchen Planner and choose to send to us as part of a quote request
- Your email address if you sign up for our newsletter or promotional updates
- Messages you send us directly by email or phone

We also collect limited technical information automatically through analytics, described below.

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
sections.body:
We use a self hosted analytics platform (Umami) to understand how visitors use our website, such as which pages are viewed and how visitors navigate the site. This analytics tool does not track you across other websites and does not sell or share data with third party advertising networks.

We use cookies and browser local storage for functional purposes, including remembering the cabinets in your quote list and any kitchen designs you save in the planner between visits. You can clear these at any time through your browser settings, though doing so may clear your saved list or design.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to respond to your quote requests, prepare and send pricing, process and fulfil confirmed orders, arrange delivery, communicate with you about your order, send newsletter updates if you have opted in, and improve our website and product offerings based on aggregate usage patterns.

sections.heading: How we share your information
sections.body:
We do not sell your personal information. We share information only as needed to operate our business, including with:
- Our email service provider, to send quotes, order confirmations, and other communications
- Our website hosting and database providers, who store and process information on our behalf
- Delivery and freight carriers, to arrange shipment of confirmed orders to your address
- Our third party financing partner, only if and when you choose to apply for financing on an order

Each of these providers is only given the information necessary to perform their specific service and is expected to handle it securely.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We retain quote requests, order information, and saved planner designs for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil orders, respond to inquiries, meet our accounting and legal obligations, and maintain records of past customers for warranty purposes. You may request deletion of your information at any time as described below, subject to any records we are required to keep by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct inaccurate information, or request that we delete your information from our records. To make any of these requests, email us at service@rtacabinetscanada.ca and we will respond within a reasonable time. Please note that deleting certain information may affect our ability to fulfil an active order or honour a warranty claim tied to that information.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
sections.body: Our website and services are intended for adults making purchasing decisions for their home and are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal or operational reasons. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent update. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how your information is handled, contact us at service@rtacabinetscanada.ca or by phone at (519) 914-5573.

sections.heading: Agreement to terms
sections.body: These terms of service govern your use of rtacabinetscanada.ca and any quote requests or orders placed with RTA Cabinets Canada, based in London, Ontario. By using our website or requesting a quote, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our website or services.

sections.heading: Quotes are not orders
sections.body: Building a list or design in our free 3D Kitchen Planner and requesting a quote does not create an order or any obligation to purchase. A quote is an estimate based on the information you provide and is not binding until you review, confirm, and pay for the order as described below. Quotes are typically provided within one business day of your request.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: All prices on our website and in quotes are listed in Canadian dollars (CAD) and are subject to correction if a pricing or typographical error occurs. If a pricing error is discovered after a quote is issued but before an order is confirmed and paid for, we will notify you of the corrected price before proceeding. Prices do not include applicable taxes or freight shipping charges outside our free local delivery area unless stated otherwise.

sections.heading: Coming soon items
sections.body: Certain products described on our website, such as our upcoming 30 inch wall cabinet line, may be listed as coming soon and are not yet available for order. We will confirm current availability when you request a quote.

sections.heading: Order confirmation and payment
sections.body: Once you review and accept a quote, your order is confirmed by payment, made by e-transfer or card invoice. We do not accept online card payment directly through our website. After a confirmed and paid order, in stock cabinets typically ship within 2 to 3 weeks.

sections.heading: Delivery and inspection
sections.body: Deliveries within 300 km of London, Ontario are free. Deliveries beyond that distance are quoted based on postal code and charged as freight shipping. All deliveries are curbside. You are responsible for inspecting your delivery upon arrival and must report any damage to service@rtacabinetscanada.ca within 48 hours of delivery, with photos and your order number, so we can process a replacement.

sections.heading: Returns
sections.body: Unopened, undamaged cabinet boxes may be returned within 30 days of delivery. The customer is responsible for return freight costs on any return. Assembled cabinets and custom or made to order items are final sale and not eligible for return. To start a return, contact service@rtacabinetscanada.ca with your order number.

sections.heading: Warranty summary
sections.body: Our cabinet boxes carry a limited lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects under normal residential use. Full details are set out in our Warranty and Returns page. The warranty does not cover damage from improper assembly, improper installation, misuse, or normal wear and tear.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: We work hard to provide accurate information, quality products, and reliable service, but our total liability for any claim relating to your order is limited to the amount you paid for the affected product. We are not responsible for indirect losses, such as costs related to renovation delays, beyond the value of the product itself. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under applicable Ontario or Canadian consumer protection law that cannot be waived.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada applicable within it, without regard to conflict of law principles.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent update. Continued use of our website after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to service@rtacabinetscanada.ca or by phone at (519) 914-5573.

sections.heading: Our limited lifetime warranty
sections.body:
RTA Cabinets Canada offers a limited lifetime warranty on our cabinet boxes against manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship, for as long as you own your home and the cabinets remain in normal residential use. This warranty covers issues such as defective plywood construction, faulty factory joinery, or finish defects present at the time of manufacture.

The warranty does not cover damage caused by improper assembly, improper installation, accidents, misuse, exposure to excess moisture or heat beyond normal kitchen conditions, normal wear and tear, or modifications made after delivery.

sections.heading: Making a warranty claim
sections.body: To make a warranty claim, email service@rtacabinetscanada.ca with your original order number, a description of the issue, and clear photos of the affected cabinet. We will review your claim and, where it is covered under this warranty, arrange for a replacement part or cabinet at no charge. Shipping for warranty replacements is handled on a case by case basis depending on the nature of the claim.

sections.heading: Sample doors
sections.body: We offer individual sample doors for 35 dollars so you can see the finish and quality in person before ordering a full kitchen. If you go on to place your first cabinet order with us, the cost of your sample door is refunded. Sample doors are not eligible for the standard cabinet return policy described below, but you may contact us with any concerns about a sample.

sections.heading: 30 day returns
sections.body:
Unopened, undamaged cabinet boxes may be returned within 30 days of the delivery date. To start a return, contact service@rtacabinetscanada.ca with your order number and the items you wish to return. The customer is responsible for arranging and paying for return freight. Once the returned items are received and inspected, a refund is issued for the product cost, excluding original outbound shipping charges where applicable.

Assembled cabinets, custom configurations, and any made to order items are final sale and cannot be returned, since these are prepared specifically for your order.

sections.heading: Damaged or incorrect deliveries
sections.body: Please inspect your delivery as soon as it arrives. Check the box count against your order and look over each box for visible damage before the carrier leaves if possible. If any item arrives damaged or if your order is missing an item, report it to service@rtacabinetscanada.ca within 48 hours of delivery, along with photos and your order number. We will arrange a replacement or correction promptly. Damage reported after 48 hours may be more difficult to resolve with our delivery carriers, so please check your order right away.

sections.heading: Expert assembly service
sections.body: If you would prefer not to assemble your cabinets yourself, our expert assembly service builds every cabinet in your order before it is delivered, for 75 dollars per cabinet. Assembled cabinets are inspected as part of the assembly process, and our limited lifetime warranty on the cabinet boxes still applies.

sections.heading: Questions about your warranty or a return
sections.body: If you are unsure whether an issue is covered under warranty, or you have any question about a return, contact us at service@rtacabinetscanada.ca or by phone at (519) 914-5573 and we will help you sort out the best path forward.
